description:
## Problem

Config.copy_with duplicates all 22 parameters from initialize. Every new config field requires changes in 3 places: getter, initialize, copy_with. This is a classic DRY violation.

## What to do

1. Investigate if Crystal has a macro or pattern to generate copy_with from the field declarations
2. If not, consider using a Crystal macro to auto-generate both initialize and copy_with from a single field definition DSL
3. Alternatively, document the pattern clearly and add a comment reminding maintainers to update all 3 locations
4. Run specs after any changes

## Why

- DRY: 22 parameters x 3 locations = 66 places to keep in sync
- Every new config field is a maintenance trap
- The Unset sentinel pattern for nullable Proc fields adds complexity
title: Simplify Config.copy_with to reduce parameter duplication
